title: DG T4 - Independent Convergence
claim: If two frameworks independently satisfy DG and preserve the same dependency graph, capability classes, collapse structure, and translation behavior, they may instantiate a shared abstract derivation object under different names.
assumptions: Structural equivalence can be defined for dependency graphs, capability classes, collapse behavior, and translation behavior.
Independence can be assessed without assuming one framework borrowed the result from the other.
definitions: Independent Convergence: equivalent DG structure reached by independent frameworks.
IC-5: shared dependency graph, capability classes, collapse behavior, and translation behavior.
equations: Models(A, DG) and Models(B, DG) and EquivalentStructure(F(A), F(B)) -> SharedAbstractDGObject(A, B)
bridges: This is a convergence criterion, not a metaphysical identity claim by itself.
negative_guards: Do not claim Independent Convergence is already Lean-proved.
Do not call vocabulary resemblance convergence.
Do not use Independent Convergence to erase real doctrinal or domain differences.
kill_conditions: The candidate permits IC-5 status without preserving dependency, capability, collapse, and translation behavior.
